tagline: Entrepreneur, shark, and mentor—ready to dive in
summary: When the cameras stop rolling, Daymond is a relentless hustler who turns ideas into brands, mentors young founders, and stays on top of the latest in tech and biohacking. He’s a hands‑on CEO who loves a good challenge and a good laugh, and he’s never shy about sharing his journey from a Queens hat shop to a global fashion empire. In his downtime he’s a fitness buff, a live‑streaming enthusiast, and a vocal advocate for smart investing.
